summary: M06 delivers the five calculators, the advice record (draft to finalised, scope snapshot, immutable afterwards, enforced again by a restrictive RLS update policy), the quote workspace with LA-6 scope checks, BI evidence and the signed share link. Routes, permissions, status and error codes match the LLD; record scope follows opportunity or party and fails closed to 404; share tokens use HMAC-SHA256 with timing-safe compare, host-tenant binding and a security log without the token; money is integer paise end to end (bigint with a safe-integer guard) and dates are IST. Gaps: the stale-quote job (expireStale) exists but is never scheduled, BI-required categories PENSION and CHILD have no test, and the web gate runner reports FAIL even though the vitest run of the same paths passes.

findings.summary: `expireStale(tenantId: string, today: string, limit = 200): Promise<{ expired: number }> {` implements the §5 stale-quote job but nothing calls it (grep for expireStale finds no scheduler, module hook or test of the service method outside the domain/repository contract), so quotes never move to EXPIRED in a running system.

`return !!detail && detail.line === 'LIFE' && detail.category !== 'TERM';` makes PENSION and CHILD (a deliberate decision) BI-required, but the selection tests only cover SAVINGS and ULIP (selection.spec.ts it.each) plus TERM and HEALTH as negatives. A change that exempted PENSION or CHILD would not fail any test.

`node scripts/gate.mjs web apps/web/src/features/advice` reported `FAIL web tests at async asyncRunEntryPointWithESMLoader ... Node.js v24.21.0` while `npx vitest run src/features/advice` passes 32 tests; the path-scoped web gate crashes before running tests, so the scoped gate cannot be used as evidence for this module (orchestrator full-suite result 609 is the evidence).

`if (!(await this.parties.summary(tx, partyId))) throw new NotFoundError('party', partyId);` insured parties are checked for existence in the tenant only, not against the caller's record scope; a salesperson can link (and see the 404 vs success difference for) a party they do not own. RLS keeps it inside the tenant and no data is returned.

`return nodeEnv === 'production' ? '' : `${env.AUTH_HS256_SECRET || ''}:share`;` outside production the share secret is derived from the auth secret; production is guarded (>= 32 chars required), but a staging deployment with NODE_ENV=development would share key material between the two uses. Document or require SHARE_TOKEN_SECRET everywhere except tests.

`const quote = await this.quotes.get(tx, verdict.payload.quoteRequestId); if (!quote) throw new NotFoundError('quote_share');` a valid link keeps resolving for SELECTED, EXPIRED or WITHDRAWN quotes (test 'the link follows the quote' asserts SELECTED shows). Acceptable by design but there is no revocation short of expiry; the public route has no module-specific rate limit.

`const humanLifeValuePaise = roundUpToLakh(surplus * annuity);` the LLD rounds only the gap up to ₹1,00,000; the implementation also rounds HLV and recommended cover. Tests pin the resulting values (129/159/104 lakh), so it is consistent but differs from the formula text.

`throw new ForbiddenError('product_out_of_scope', ...)` Recommend out-of-scope uses 403 although §3.2 says BusinessRuleError. The API table (§6) and AC-M06-05 say 403 and M05 assertInScope also throws ForbiddenError, so 403 is the consistent choice. Update the §3.2 text to match.

BI required for every LIFE category except TERM (including CHILD, PENSION) is the safe reading of the IRDAI rule and is stricter than the LLD list (savings/ULIP/pension); it fails safe. The LLD should name CHILD explicitly, and the missing tests above should be added.

Floater amounts are derived from the health sum-insured formula (LLD gives no floater amount formula); tests pin 10L floater / 30L individual total for the reference case. Acceptable as an educational guide; record the derivation in assumptions docs.

`!inScope({ ownerMemberId: summary.ownerMemberId, orgUnitId: summary.orgUnitId }, ...)` lead-captured parties have no owner, so under OWN scope an advice record or calculator save by party (without an opportunity) is a 404 for the capturing salesperson; it fails closed (no leak) and is an M03/M04 ownership gap, not an M06 defect.

`bi.acknowledge({ method: input.method, ...` CUSTOMER_LINK acknowledgement is recorded by an authenticated staff member; there is no customer-facing acknowledgement endpoint (the public share route is read-only per LLD), so the method is attestation, not proof from the customer.

architectNotes: Reviewer ran the three scoped gates (core, web, int) and opened every cited test. Share-token verification, tenant and scope handling, event payloads (ids, enums, paise totals only), metric labels (calculator and source enums) and the no-store header were checked against the code and found consistent with the LLD.
